# Netsidian 0.2.0

Mind maps connect ordinary Markdown documents on an interactive canvas, and
Memos has a more compact writing and browsing experience.

## Mind maps

- Create a blank map from Maps in the workspace. Each map stores its layout in
  `mindmap.md`; ideas remain ordinary Markdown documents.
- Pan and zoom with a matching dotted background. Arrange branches using actual
  card dimensions, or position cards freely.
- Hover or focus a card to reveal connection points. Drag between card borders,
  or release on empty canvas to create a connected idea. Arrow direction follows
  the attached border; Escape cancels.
- Resize cards to show rendered Markdown and linked-file chips. Select a card
  header for its editable Visual Markdown preview; double-click opens the document.
- Drop a document or attachment onto empty canvas to create a Markdown card
  linking it. Drop onto an existing card to add a file link. Source files stay
  in place; physical moves remain separate, confirmed actions.
- Use keyboard branching, connector labels, colors, layout undo/redo, workspace
  tabs, and integration with existing links, backlinks, graph and document history.
- Revision-aware autosave and browser recovery protect pending layout changes.

## Compact Memos

- Removed the timeline promo, density selector, card avatars and draft hint.
- Search and folder filters sit on the right on desktop; narrow screens retain
  the filter dialog. Save is aligned to the right.
- Memos inherits the app accent by default and automatically applies `memo`
  without showing a redundant composer chip.
- Blurred drafts render Markdown and hashtag chips. Returning to editing retains
  the text and cursor position.

## Compatibility and scope

Existing Netsidian state and documents are retained; this release adds no new
runtime dependency or database schema. Board-specific layout and visual
connections stay in the board file, while content and semantic file links stay
in Markdown. Existing maps and explicitly collected files remain readable.

Maps currently support 200 document nodes and 400 connectors. Folder groups,
multi-selection/group movement and live collaborative cursors are not included.
Backup/restore preserves document identities; copying Markdown alone into a
newly indexed vault requires relinking map references. See
[the mind map guide](https://github.com/pentaqilo/netsidian/blob/0.2.0/docs/mindmaps.md).

## Downloads and deployment

Desktop archives: Linux x64, Windows x64, macOS Intel and Apple Silicon.
Linux requires GTK4 and WebKitGTK 6.0; Windows requires Microsoft Edge WebView2
Runtime. macOS bundles are ad-hoc signed and are not Apple notarized.

```sh
docker run -d --name netsidian -p 127.0.0.1:3000:3000 \
  -v netsidian-state:/netsidian-state ghcr.io/pentaqilo/netsidian:0.2.0
```

The release includes the matching Helm chart, `SHA256SUMS`, and
`docker-image.txt` recording the immutable container digest.

## Validation before publication

279 frontend tests, TypeScript checks and the production build passed. Backend
tests and `go vet` passed with the server build tag. Independent browser review
covered native file drops, connector gestures, resize/reload persistence,
compact Memos, and desktop/mobile layouts in dark and light themes.
